brief.persona: I am calling Harbor Hardware about an online order delivery.
brief.objective: Learn why the original delivery failed and reschedule the missed items for any no-fee delivery slot this week.
facts: The customer is Alex Rivera, phone +15555550123, email alex@example.com, delivery ZIP 94107.
The online order number is HH-12345.
The missed delivery contains three bags of water-softener salt; a separately shipped drain auger must not be changed.
Leave the salt outside on the porch or driveway.
If the associate cannot provide the original failure reason, record it as unavailable rather than dropping that objective.
Do not accept a fee, substitute an item, cancel anything, or schedule outside this week.

authorizedCommitments: Reschedule the three salt bags to any no-fee delivery slot this week at the same address.

menuHints: Choose order status before delivery support.

fields.name: failureReason
fields.description: Why the original delivery failed, or unavailable if the associate cannot provide it.

fields.name: rescheduledDelivery
fields.description: The confirmed replacement delivery date and fee, or unavailable if not rescheduled.
